Subject: Request: 30m technical onboarding timebox — Forestline (post-discovery)

Hi Jake —

Thanks again for the time last week. Based on the discovery call, it sounds like Forestline wants to validate latency and multi-tenant isolation patterns for a bursty inference workload and review placement options for private deployment. To keep momentum, would you and Maya be available for a focused 30-minute technical onboarding timebox where we: 

- Walk the proposed topology (VPC + Dedicated GPU pool)
- Validate data flow and KMS integration points
- Agree on a short integration checklist and next steps (runbook items)

Proposed 30-minute windows (Pacific Time):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Aug 3, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Wed Aug 4, 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, share two slots that do and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached the discovery notes and a 30-minute agenda.

Agenda high-level: 5m intros, 10m topology + SLOs, 10m integration/credentials + runbook sketch, 5m next steps

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0117

Attachments: Forestline-Discovery-Notes.pdf; 30min-Technical-Agenda.docx
